1.w: And Moses gathered together all the congregation of the sons of Israel, and he said to them, “These [are] the words that YHWH has commanded—to do them:

2.w: Six days work shall be done, and the seventh day shall be for you⁺ holy, a Sabbath of complete rest to YHWH. Every doer of work on it shall be put to death.

3.w: You⁺ shall not kindle a fire in any of your⁺ dwellings on the Sabbath day.”

4.w: And Moses spoke to all the congregation of the sons of Israel, saying, “This [is] the word that YHWH has commanded, saying,

5.w: take from among you⁺ a contribution to YHWH; everyone of a willing heart, he shall bring it [as] a contribution to YHWH: gold, and silver, and bronze,

6.w: and blue, and purple, and scarlet yarn; and fine linen, and goats’ [hair];

7.w: and ram skins dyed red, and badger skins; and acacia wood;

8.w: and oil for the light; and spices for the anointing oil and for the incense of spices;

9.w: and onyx stones, and stones as settings for the ephod and for the breastplate.

10.w: And all wise of heart among you⁺ shall come, and they shall make all that YHWH has commanded:

11.w: The tabernacle, its tent, and its covering, its clasps, and its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its bases;

12.w: the ark and its poles, the mercy seat, and the veil of the screen;

13.w: the table and its poles and all its vessels, and the Bread of the Presence;

14.w: and the lampstand of the light, and its vessels, and its lamps, and the oil of the light;

15.w: and the altar of incense and its poles; and the anointing oil and the incense; of spices and the screen of the door for the entrance of the tabernacle;

16.w: the altar of the burnt offering and the bronze grate that [is] for it, its poles and all its vessels; the basin and its stand;

17.w: the hangings of the court, its pillars and its bases, and the screen of the gate of the court;

18.w: the pegs of the tabernacle, and the pegs of the court, and their cords;

19.w: the woven garments for ministering in the Holy Place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons to minister as priests.”

20.w: And all the congregation of the sons of Israel departed from before the face of Moses.

21.w: And they came in—every man whom his heart lifted him and everyone whom his spirit impelled him—[and] they brought a contribution of YHWH for the work of the Tent of Meeting, and for all its service, and for the holy garments.

22.w: And they came in, the men, man along with the women—everyone willing of heart—they brought hooks and earrings and rings and necklaces, every article of gold, and everyone who waved a wave offering of gold to YHWH.

23.w: And every man with whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet yarn, and fine linen, and goats’ [hair], and rams skins dyed red, and badger skins, brought [them] in.

24.w: Everyone lifting a contribution of silver and bronze brought in a contribution of YHWH. And everyone with whom was found acacia wood for every work of the service brought [it].

25.w: And every woman wise of heart spun with her hands, and they brought in what she had spun of the blue and the purple, of the scarlet yarn and of the fine linen.

26.w: And all the women whose heart was lifted up with wisdom spun the goats’ [hair].

27.w: And the rulers brought the onyx stones and stones as the settings for the ephod and for the breastplate,

28.w: and the spice, and the oil for the light and for the anointing oil and for the incense of spices.

29.w: Every man and woman whose heart impelled him to bring in for all the work that YHWH had commanded to be done by the hand of Moses—the sons of Israel brought a freewill offering to YHWH.

30.w: And Moses said to the sons of Israel, “See, YHWH has called by name Bezalel son of Uri son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

31.w: And He has filled him with the Spirit of God in wisdom and in understanding and in knowledge and in all manner of workmanship,

32.w: and to design artistic works, to work in gold and in silver and in bronze,

33.w: and in cutting stone for setting, and in cutting wood, and to work in all manner of artistic workmanship.

34.w: And to teach He has given in his heart—he and Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

35.w: He has filled them with wisdom of heart to do every work of an engraver and designer and weaver in the blue and the purple, in the scarlet yarn, and in the fine linen, and of a weaver—those who do every work and those who design artistic works.
